clips.title: The story
paras: Your return from Moonglade brings you back to Elder Rise, where Turak Runetotem awaits. Dendrite Starblaze sends you home after your communion with the Great Bear Spirit, so your training can continue among your people.

Moonglade brings night elf and tauren practitioners of nature magic together in the Cenarion Circle, apart from the mortal world’s factional divides. After your communion with the Great Bear Spirit, Dendrite Starblaze sends you back to your people. Night elves often see tauren as fledglings in Cenarius’s formal teachings, yet Starblaze recognizes the wisdom and balance of Turak Runetotem.

You climb back to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and stand before Turak Runetotem, changed by your rite. Communion with ancient totemic spirits such as the Great Bear Spirit runs deep in tauren culture, but the Path of the Claw asks for serious commitment. Your spiritual bond is forged, and Turak prepares you to put your new strength and endurance into practice.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. Though the tauren are thought to be young in the ways of Cenarius, Turak Runetotem walks with much balance in the presence of nature. Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.
Go now, young one. We shall meet again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome back, friend. I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the Claw... A little bewildering, but very intense. I know it was that way with me.

The Great Bear Spirit has been a part of Azeroth as long as Azeroth has existed in the heavens. We tauren listen closely to such spirits, and we all prosper from its purpose. Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose. Listen closely...
